enabled.description: Enable translation for existing TTS calls

emotion_enabled.description: Infer and apply basic emotion to supported TTS providers

tts_provider_id.description: TTS provider used for translated speech
tts_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the selection mode. An explicit invalid ID falls back to the untouched upstream path.

tts_selection_mode.description: TTS selection behavior when no provider ID is selected

fish_model.description: Fish Audio model sent in every Fish request
fish_model.hint: The free default is sent explicitly; the plugin never retries with a paid model.

translation_provider_id.description: Translation LLM provider (empty uses the current session provider)
translation_provider_id.hint: This provider is used only for translation and does not replace the chat provider.

custom_target_language.hint: Required only when target_language is custom.

translation_timeout_seconds.description: Translation LLM call timeout in seconds
translation_timeout_seconds.hint: Applies after a concurrency slot is acquired. Provider HTTP/SDK timeouts remain independently configured on the selected LLM provider.

translation_queue_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait for a translation concurrency slot
translation_queue_timeout_seconds.hint: Keeps a busy translation queue from delaying QQ replies indefinitely; range is 1–60 seconds.

max_input_chars.description: Maximum source text length; longer text uses original-language TTS

custom_prompts_enabled.description: Enable custom translation and emotion prompts

translation_prompt_text.hint: Placeholders: {target_language}=resolved target language; {emotion_options}=allowed basic emotions; {fish_cues}=Fish cue allowlist (empty outside Fish mode). Use double braces {{ and }} for literal braces. Unknown placeholders are rejected.

emotion_prompt_text.hint: Placeholders: {target_language}=resolved target language; {emotion_options}=allowed basic emotions; {fish_cues}=Fish cue allowlist (empty outside Fish mode). Use double braces {{ and }} for literal braces. Unknown placeholders are rejected.

neutral_inherits.description: Allow neutral segments to inherit the current reply emotion

preview_text.description: TTS preview text (empty uses a safe sample)

diagnostic_log_level.hint: Minimal logs warnings only; normal adds call outcomes; verbose adds phase events. Message text, translations, endpoints, proxy addresses, and credentials are never logged.

diagnostic_event_buffer_size.description: Recent safe diagnostic events kept in memory
diagnostic_event_buffer_size.hint: Visible only to administrators through the Control Page or /tts_diagnostics; cleared on reload.

slow_phase_warning_seconds.description: Warn when translation or TTS exceeds this duration
